F02-C06.behavior: Use original thread/message context and exact version reads. Scoped incarnation or period changes require the producer continuity seam plus explicit historical C17 permission; no ID/name-based grant.

F03-COMMENT-MEMBERSHIP.behavior: Create section-comment id/version/full-digest membership only from authorized capture, share exact membership across all readers and formats, and open current C06 conversation through fresh C05+C06 reads without changing the review.
F03-COMMENT-MEMBERSHIP.limits: CI03 canonical history uses v1-to-v2; increment05 upgrades the same path to required v3-to-v4. The synthetic visual fixture already renders v3/v1. Current-conversation browser producer remains a controlled boundary.

F04-ARTIFACT-POLICY.behavior: Keep the stored historical policy stamp immutable; authorize against current state/host/domain ACL and exact review, inclusion and byte digests. Legitimate policy/access rollover may retrieve identical bytes; revocation, substituted review or other actor is denied.
F04-ARTIFACT-POLICY.limits: This does not grant the external C08 viewer private-report policy.

F05-SELECTION-AGE.behavior: Ignore only the clock-derived Request age in material selection comparison while preserving the captured age. Material stage/status/missingness changes still invalidate the selection.
F05-SELECTION-AGE.limits: No engine or Procurement source calculation changed.

F06-CLOSURE-WORK.behavior: Read authorized C05 closure contexts for the same canonical action; WP08 attaches them to one existing My Work item. Reuse the same handoff/relation, preserve original financial basis, follow current action completion and omit C05 metadata when that access is lost, including at egress.

F07-SCHEMA-ACL.behavior: Canonical closed projection decode, strict extensions, complete source/evidence collection including comparison and drilldowns, no unknown private bytes; batch dedup uses full reference digest only. Correct canonical evidence digests in affected fixtures.
F07-SCHEMA-ACL.limits: No permissive schema fallback; owner output-schemas/ports are consumed verbatim.

F08-DASHBOARD-CONSUMPTION.behavior: Consume the published Dashboard agenda factory with real scoped sources, domains and SQLite; exact counts/order/subsets, homonymous record identity, empty selection, Talent denial and revocation.
F08-DASHBOARD-CONSUMPTION.limits: New test is pending hosted execution. Published producer b13b28a8c8843b1c1b8cd81a3c7e627e700287de blob32b95d4a270cb9b9c987c6cb3097dbd6de975895 is foreign and must be consumed verbatim.

F09-VISUAL.behavior: Retain the four original artifacts and all 85 pixel-identical rendered frames; two historical-comment formats add eight fully inspected frames. Next browser capture includes the full page.
F09-VISUAL.limits: Visual fixtures are synthetic and do not establish mounted host/native authority.

HOST_MOUNT.remaining: Mount the current application, real C06 history/continuity, routineProduct and canonical work reviewContexts callback; run the integrated journeys on published owners without replacement fixtures.

C07_FACTUAL_BODY.remaining: Own WP07/WP09 decoder and consumer pass CI03. The real native terminal output/admission witness and mounted routineProduct remain required; no stale archived input promoted.

DASHBOARD_AGENDA.remaining: Consume exact current Dashboard agenda blob and execute dashboard-agenda-consumer.test.ts. Existing generic consumer coverage remains valid within its controlled-port scope.

C06_COMMENT_HISTORY.remaining: Literal v3-to-v4 regression is prepared05; host must supply explicit historical grants and physical continuity. CI03 actor/history fixtures do not prove that production grant.

C17_REMOVED_SOURCE.remaining: Prove domain-authorized deleted-source historical reads under current ACL, including replacement and revoke negatives. C06_ACTION_CONTINUITY.remaining: Execute closure-work.test.ts over actual handoff, action completion, one canonical work row, exact C05 context and egress revoke. Host wiring remains external afterward.

WP14_OUTCOME_HISTORY.remaining: Consume authenticated original observed/comparison projections with current ACL and stable source identity; old raw result fixtures are only consumer proof.

C09_HISTORICAL_RESULTS.remaining: Reopen original calculation/decision/sensitivity result with current ACL after source advance. WP07 renders and validates captured immutable results; it does not rebuild engine histories.
